# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta18

## Exact polygon gate areas

This beta adds visual support for the exact mower-local gate-area polygons introduced by Navimower 0.4.4-beta32.

- Single-mower maps now draw `gate_areas[].polygon` directly when three or more valid X/Y points are available.
- Multi-mower maps render the same polygon inside each mower's existing site transform, so the displayed area follows the mower map orientation correctly.
- Gate-area labels remain available in Single-mower view and are positioned from the rendered polygon instead of its compatibility bounding box.
- Polygon points participate in Single-mower layout bounds.
- Existing `x_min`, `x_max`, `y_min`, `y_max` gate areas remain fully supported and continue to render as rectangles when no polygon is present.

The Map Card does not calculate gate occupancy itself. Navimower 0.4.4-beta32 remains authoritative for the gate-area binary sensor and uses exact point-in-polygon membership with fresh MQTT position data.

### Compatibility

Recommended companion integration: **Navimower 0.4.4-beta32 or newer**. Older integrations continue to work with the unchanged rectangular gate-area rendering fallback.
